caption: The Planning workspace
preconditions: Planning e2e stack on slot 1 (client http://localhost:9021, API http://localhost:5021/api, DEFAULT_TIMEZONE Australia/Sydney), captured with run-capture-planning.sh. The server image must be built from the same superdesk-planning checkout as the client (e2e-up.sh --rebuild), otherwise the Planning and Assignments workspaces do not load.

Seeded with `python3 seed_planning.py --api-url http://localhost:5021/api --reset` on the same Sydney day as the capture (it creates every event, planning item, coverage, assignment, agenda, template, filter, layout and location this entry needs; see SEED.md).
steps: Open #/planning and wait for [data-test-id="planning-list-panel"] to be visible
click [data-test-id="view-COMBINED"] (Events & Planning view; Group by day is on by default)
notes: Overview of the workspace: two toolbar rows (search + plus icon; filter icon, view switch Events & Planning / Events only / Planning only, Group by day, three-dot Actions), the list header (list filter menu, Assigned to, date controls) and the event preview on the right. Rows: P1 is folded under its event E1 (Show 1 planning item), P2 stands alone. Item creation in the e2e fixtures uses POST /api/planning_prepopulate (addItems in e2e/playwright/utils/common/app.ts). Times are given in Sydney wall-clock time; convert to UTC ISO strings when seeding. The opened-articles bar at the bottom shows nothing if no item is open.

notes: Shows the Schedule section (Repeats switch, Event Starts, Event Ends, Timezone which appears once a start time is set) and the top of the Description section (Slugline, Event Name, Description, Calendars, Occurrence Status). Do not click Create. Field selectors from e2e/playwright/page-object-models/planning/events/eventEditor.ts. The client date format on the e2e stack is DD/MM/YYYY (superdesk.config.js view.dateformat). The date and time inputs are masked planning inputs: if a plain fill does not stick, type the value character by character (the e2e Input helper does the same). A fixed future date (12/12/2045, as in e2e/playwright/events/event_template.spec.ts) keeps the shot stable.
